title: Arrow of time within SBT scope, in one package: three finite certificates (protocol trap + arrow-DPI + record monotonicity) recover the standard within-scope Loschmidt moral
scientific_domain: Thermodynamics / nonequilibrium statistical mechanics / information physics (finite-state discrete-time Markov chains)
argument_family: paradox-resolution (repaired to: within-scope recovery + reorganization of standard stochastic-thermodynamics facts into three separated finite certificates)
revised_one_sentence_claim: Within SBT's finite audited scope (A_FIN finite state, A_STAT stationary, A_REV microreversible, common-pi, A_AUT autonomous, deterministic lens), three standard facts are consolidated into one closure package as three logically distinct finite certificates: (i) a reversible (detailed-balance) chain at stationarity has zero path-reversal KL audit Sigma_T=0 at every horizon T>=1 (theorem-grade, NG_PROTOCOL_TRAP, a bare detailed-balance => zero-arrow statement on any finite chain); (ii) deterministic coarse-graining cannot increase that audit, A_T(mu,K;f) <= A_T(mu,K) (theorem-grade, NG_ARROW_DPI, deterministic/TV case Lean-certified as tvdist_pushforward_le); and (iii) when an arrow exists it is the monotone direction of a descended record quotient (F38, a SET-THEORETIC quotient-descent statement, NOT a thermodynamic theorem); the example-grade content that this holds 'even with hidden noncommuting protocol/clock coordinates' is carried by the separate Protocol_Trap CONSTRUCTION (a paper-level reversible-lift closure lemma plus a single 3-state benchmark with entrywise commutator norm 0.1296, EPR=0, lifted EPR<1e-16), NOT by the NG_PROTOCOL_TRAP theorem itself; so a sustained arrow requires a genuine cycle affinity (P6_drive, Schnakenberg current x affinity), and within scope a fake arrow cannot be manufactured from reversible micro-dynamics plus deterministic coarse-graining plus hidden holonomy alone -- this is an A-class RECOVERY of standard facts (Kelly 1979; Cover-Thomas; Schnakenberg 1976; Eddington 1928) where Sigma_T/EPR are INFORMATIONAL path-space-KL proxies, NOT physical entropy production, and it does NOT derive the Second Law or the Past Hypothesis (which remain external inputs and are card-author framing absent from the source papers).
new_minimum_viable_result: A single 4-6 page synthesis note ('Arrow of time within SBT scope, in one package') that: (1) fixes one closure package T=(Z,f,Sigma_f,E,A) with Z=X x Phi finite, mu=pi x s stationary, microreversible on support, autonomous lift; (2) states the three certificates over that one hypothesis set, EXPLICITLY separating theorem-grade content (NG_PROTOCOL_TRAP bare detailed-balance => Sigma_T=0 for all T [No-Go line 62]; NG_ARROW_DPI deterministic path-KL DPI [No-Go thm:NG_ARROW_DPI], deterministic/TV case Lean-certified tvdist_pushforward_le) from example-grade content (the noncommuting reversible-lift closure + the 3-state benchmark, paper-level/numerical only in Protocol_Trap); (3) supplies the one-paragraph notation-glue lemma reconciling K vs P, ell vs f, X x Phi vs general Z across the three papers; (4) reproduces the existing 3-state benchmark -- entrywise commutator norm ||K0K1-K1K0||_entrywise = 0.1296 (holonomy witness, labeled per Protocol_Trap line 191 as the ENTRYWISE not operator inf-norm; operator inf-norm = 0.2592), EPR(K0)=EPR(K1)=0, stroboscopic EPR(K0K1)=0.0833178 (external-schedule arrow), autonomous lifted EPR<1e-16 (the trap: holonomy present, arrow absent), driven-clock EPR_lifted(b)=alpha*beta*b*log((1+b)/(1-b)) overlay; (5) keeps F38 strictly as the set-theoretic record-monotonicity descent reading (Eddington); (6) foregrounds the load-bearing common-pi hypothesis with the verified counterexample (two reversible kernels with DIFFERENT equilibria under a reversible clock give a lift with positive EPR ~0.0144 at its own stationary law); (7) attaches the disclaimer block (Sigma_T/EPR informational proxies not physical entropy; finite-state discrete-time only; deterministic lens only; does NOT derive the Second Law or Past Hypothesis). No new mathematics beyond bookkeeping; pure consolidation of NG_ARROW_DPI + NG_PROTOCOL_TRAP + Protocol_Trap construction + F38.
changes_made: SPLIT THEOREM-GRADE FROM EXAMPLE-GRADE (the central repair): the original one-sentence claim credited the holonomy-robust ('even when hidden noncommuting coordinates are present') content to NG_PROTOCOL_TRAP. Verified against the source: the verbatim NG_PROTOCOL_TRAP theorem (No-Go line 62, macro ThmStmtNGPROTOCOLTRAP) is a BARE statement -- finite chain, detailed balance => reversal-invariant path law => zero KL, plus the deterministic-observation specialization -- with NO lift, NO clock, NO X x Phi, NO noncommutativity. The noncommuting-holonomy-robust content lives entirely in the separate Protocol_Trap paper as (a) the reversible-lift closure lemma (paper-level, NOT Lean-certified) and (b) one 3-state numerical benchmark. The claim now attributes that content to the Protocol_Trap CONSTRUCTION, not the no-go theorem.

NARROWED 'DISSOLVES THE LOSCHMIDT WORRY' TO 'RECOVERS THE WITHIN-SCOPE MORAL': grep confirms the words 'Loschmidt', 'Past Hypothesis', and 'Second Law' appear ZERO times in both Protocol_Trap and the No-Go paper (the source papers claim only 'P3 route dependence is not an arrow-of-time certificate'). The Loschmidt/Past-Hypothesis/Second-Law framing is therefore a card-author OVERLAY; relabeled as such and downgraded to 'recovers the within-scope Loschmidt moral as three separated finite certificates'.

FOREGROUNDED THE INFORMATIONAL-PROXY CAVEAT IN THE HEADLINE: Sigma_T/EPR are path-space-KL audit proxies, NOT physical entropy production; coarse-graining can HIDE real dissipation, so an audited 'zero arrow' is audit-relative, not a physical-reversibility certificate (ledger 'No micro-thermodynamic interface' line 107; disclaimer 'EP/Sigma are informational proxies, not physical entropy').

KEPT F38 STRICTLY STRUCTURAL: F38's Lean-'faithful' status (SelfReferenceLimits.ArrowFromRecordMonotonicity.arrow_from_record_monotonicity) certifies a SET-THEORETIC quotient-descent statement (existence of a monotone descended bar-kappa), verified by reading thm:F38 -- whose layer instantiations are git commits / stratigraphy / tree rings, NOT a thermodynamic arrow. The card now flags F38 as the structural Eddington reading only, never 'the' physical arrow.

FOREGROUNDED COMMON-PI AS LOAD-BEARING WITH A VERIFIED COUNTEREXAMPLE: Protocol_Trap line 228 states 'The assumption of a common stationary pi is essential'. The repair states this prominently and records the skeptic-verified counterexample (differing conditional equilibria under a reversible clock => positive lift EPR ~0.0144), so 'reversible parts alone' is explicitly insufficient.

RELABELED THE COMMUTATOR WITNESS as the ENTRYWISE / max-entry norm (0.1296), consistent with Protocol_Trap line 191 which calls it the 'entrywise commutator norm'; noted the operator inf-norm (max abs row-sum) is 0.2592 to forestall the mislabeling objection.

CONVERTED THE 'ONE PACKAGE' RHETORIC TO AN EXPLICIT GLUE LEMMA + HYPOTHESIS SET: the consolidation is stated as a notation-glue lemma over one declared bundle (A_FIN, A_STAT, A_REV, common-pi, A_AUT, deterministic lens), with each escape route (stochastic lens, broken common-pi, non-stationary init, external schedule) given equal prominence to the trap, to avoid scope-gerrymandering.

RECLASSIFIED THE CONTRIBUTION AS A-CLASS RECOVERY + REORGANIZATION, NOT A RETRODICTION: every quantitative claim is a standard theorem (Kelly, Cover-Thomas, Schnakenberg, Eddington) already proved/computed in the cited SBT papers (ledger already_claimed_retrodictions rows 157-159); the value-add is the clean three-way SEPARATION (no-fake-arrow-from-coarse-graining / no-fake-arrow-from-holonomy / positive-arrow=cycle-affinity) plus partial Lean anchoring, not new physics.
remaining_objections: NOT A PREDICTION OR RETRODICTION (intrinsic, not repairable): the target IS a bundle of standard theorems; the card recovers them by citation. is_actually_new=false, beats_baseline=false (all four skeptics concur). Novelty content for a specialist is essentially nil; the only genuine contribution is reorganization + auditing discipline.

IMPORTS THE MEANING OF DIRECTIONALITY (not repairable): Sigma_T = D_KL(forward||reversed) = T*EPR and the cycle-affinity log-ratio 1-form ARE Schnakenberg's stochastic-thermodynamics thermodynamic-force objects (ledger hidden_physics_dependence lines 194-196: SBT 'imports the entire stochastic-thermodynamics interpretation as the MEANING of directionality'). The calculus supplies finite re-proofs, not a derivation of why path-KL is the arrow.

HIGH COSMETIC FLEXIBILITY (controlled, not hidden): the SAME apparatus yields the opposite observation (a positive arrow) via one knob -- b>0 (driven EPR=alpha*beta*b*log((1+b)/(1-b))), relabeling the schedule 'external' (stroboscopic EPR=0.0833), or breaking common-pi (EPR~0.0144). The defense is that this flexibility is transparently tagged to a NAMED cause, and the specific 'fake arrow from reversibility + deterministic coarse-graining + hidden holonomy alone' is provably EXCLUDED by theorem, not parameter-suppressed. But the 'zero arrow' is a consequence of the full conjunction, not of 'reversible-looking parts' alone.

EXAMPLE-GRADE PIECES NOT MACHINE-CHECKED (repairable only by the stronger result): the reversible-lift closure (random-scan convex combination preserves detailed balance) and the EPR decomposition EPR_lifted=alpha*EPR_clock are paper-level/numerical only; only the deterministic TV-DPI (tvdist_pushforward_le) and the abstract F38 descent are in Lean. Until Lean-certified, R013 adds nothing a reader of the three source papers lacks beyond the glue lemma.

STOCHASTIC-LENS DPI OUT OF CERTIFIED CORE (genuine scope gap): ledger line 111 'No stochastic-lens backbone in the certified core'; the physics examples use stochastic Q_f pervasively, so the 'coarse-graining cannot fake an arrow' claim is certified only for deterministic observation. The stochastic generalization is real work, not bookkeeping.

DOES NOT TOUCH THE ACTUAL LOSCHMIDT/PAST-HYPOTHESIS PROBLEM (correctly disclaimed): SBT does not derive the Second Law or the low-entropy boundary condition; the 'dissolution' is only of a within-scope strawman (manufacturing an arrow from reversible parts + deterministic coarse-graining + holonomy alone), not the cosmological puzzle. The note must never be written as deriving either.

NO SELECTION PRINCIPLE FOR THE LENS / RECORD ALGEBRA (F38 fragility): F38 is parametric in a hand-chosen record quotient r and status preorder; which coarse-graining 'nature' picks is undetermined input (pointer-basis disclaimer, ledger line 102), so the audit verdict is contingent on a hand-chosen lens.

score_rationale.impact: 2.0 -- slightly above the sibling R014 (1.5) because the value is not a single recovered number but a reusable CONCEPTUAL discipline: cleanly separating three notions routinely conflated in arrow-of-time / Loschmidt discussions (coarse-graining-hidden asymmetry via DPI; hidden-holonomy non-arrow via the protocol trap; genuine-drive arrow via cycle affinity), with P3 holonomy provably NOT a directionality certificate. Still bounded: no new knowledge for a stat-mech specialist, all content is standard.
score_rationale.execution_ease: 5.0 -- Class A, pure consolidation. The three certificates are already proved at paper level (two with Lean anchors); the numerical benchmark exists with a public reproducibility repo (github.com/ioannist/six-birds-protocol-trap). MVP is a 4-6 page note with one trivial glue lemma; days, not weeks.
score_rationale.plausibility: 5.0 -- every load-bearing claim is a forced theorem (detailed balance => reversal-invariant path law => zero KL; deterministic DPI) whose conclusion holds for ALL parameter values; the benchmark numbers were independently reproduced by every skeptic (0.1296, EPR=0, stroboscopic 0.0833178, lift EPR<1e-16, driven 0.2472/1.1925, Sigma_2=0.4944, Sigma_3=0.7416). score_rationale.non_ad_hocness: 3.0 -- the cycle-affinity / detailed-balance log-ratio 1-form mechanism is genuinely REUSED across R013/R014/R015 and the audit-DPI co-spine across R004/R028 (not a one-off trick), and the no-go conclusions carry effectively ZERO fitting freedom (forced by hypotheses). Capped at 3.0 because the toy kernels were reverse-engineered to EXHIBIT the phenomenon (noncommuting AND reversible), the random-scan product-form lift is a chosen convenience ('not the only possible lift'), and the autonomy framing (schedule internal vs external) is an assumption that flips the result.
score_rationale.discriminative_power: 0.5 -- opposite-world fully passes: one knob (b>0, external schedule, or broken common-pi) produces the opposite observation (a positive arrow). The load-bearing no-go is a forced theorem that cannot fail and therefore carries zero retrodictive risk; it forbids one specific opposite world by theorem but predicts nothing new. No observation could falsify a definitional consequence of detailed balance + DPI.
score_rationale.audience_legibility: 4.5 -- crisp, fully explicit, reproducible, and speaks the exact languages of three communities (stat-mech: EPR/cycle affinity; information theory: path-KL/DPI; philosophy of physics: arrow/record monotonicity). Two Lean anchors (tvdist_pushforward_le, arrow_from_record_monotonicity) raise machine-checkability legibility. Slightly above R014 because the three-way separation is a memorable, teachable organizing frame.
score_rationale.precision: 4.0 -- sharp finite statements with no fitted constants, all numerics exact to ~1e-16. Capped below R014's 4.5 because the headline bundles three certificates of DIFFERENT grades (two theorem-grade, the holonomy-robust piece example-grade/un-mechanized, F38 set-theoretic-only) under one sentence; the precision is over the theory's own inputs and EPR is an informational proxy (disclaimer-bounded), not a physical dissipation rate.
score_rationale.robustness: 4.0 -- the trap (Sigma_T=0) survives for ALL T, ALL alpha, ALL noncommuting reversible K_phi -- robust. But it is destroyed by exactly the foregrounded hypotheses: drop common-pi (positive EPR ~0.0144, explicitly 'essential'), drop stationarity, drop autonomy (external schedule, EPR=0.0833), or move to a stochastic lens (DPI Lean-certified only for deterministic/TV). These are honestly disclosed load-bearing hypotheses, not hidden cushions, so robustness is real but conditional.
score_rationale.baseline_advantage: 0.5 -- none. The standard account (Kelly detailed-balance zero EPR; Cover-Thomas DPI; Schnakenberg current x affinity; Eddington record monotonicity) reaches every conclusion with zero SBT machinery. SBT RECOVERS and reorganizes; it does not beat the baseline. The 0.5 (not 0) credits the genuine reorganizational discipline (the three-way separation + 'P3 is not an arrow' guard) that the flat standard narrative leaves implicit.
score_rationale.publication_potential: 2.0 -- as new physics, unpublishable (already known, no new content, no prediction). Its realistic home is a short methods/perspective note or an arrow-of-time-audit appendix consolidating the corpus, OR a formal-methods venue IF the two paper-level pieces (reversible-lift closure + EPR decomposition) are Lean-certified end to end (the stronger result), which would be the only genuinely new deliverable. Marginally above R014 because the falsification-first audit-template framing (a guard for switching/Floquet/stroboscopic Markov models against scheduling-artifact arrows) has standalone perspective-paper value.

bin_rationale: B (foundational sanity check). This is a correct-but-already-known A-class RECOVERY whose value is as an internal consistency anchor and a reusable separation discipline (DPI vs protocol trap vs cycle affinity), with the protocol trap as the honest backbone that makes any positive directionality claim credible precisely because it FORBIDS attributing an arrow to coarse-graining or hidden holonomy. audit_summary.audit_verdict: PASS (low overfitting risk; honest A-class recovery, not a fit). The load-bearing claims (NG_PROTOCOL_TRAP, NG_ARROW_DPI) are FORCED theorems with effectively zero fitting freedom; the toy kernels were constructed to EXHIBIT the theorem-forced phenomenon (no measured constant chased, no parameter fit). Caveats: every quantitative statement is an imported standard theorem; the opposite world (a positive arrow) is reachable with one knob but transparently tagged to a named cause; F38 certifies a set-theoretic descent, not a thermodynamic arrow; Sigma_T/EPR are informational proxies. Must never be written as deriving the Second Law or the Past Hypothesis.

skeptic_panel_summary.consensus: All four skeptics: is_actually_new=false, beats_baseline=false; no fatal objections. The mathematics is correct and every numeric reproduces exactly; the verdict is fixed by the novelty question, not by correctness. Unanimous load-bearing acceptance conditions, all honored in the repair: (1) attribute the noncommuting-holonomy content to the Protocol_Trap CONSTRUCTION, not the bare NG_PROTOCOL_TRAP theorem; (2) state Sigma_T/EPR as informational proxies (coarse-graining can hide dissipation); (3) keep F38 set-theoretic-only; (4) foreground common-pi as essential and load-bearing; (5) present as an A-class recovery + reorganization, never as deriving the Second Law or Past Hypothesis. Two serious objections raised by the EFT/recovery skeptic that the repair specifically addresses: the 'dissolves Loschmidt' framing is an overlay absent from the source papers (now relabeled), and the commutator witness is the entrywise/max-entry norm not the operator inf-norm (now relabeled, with 0.2592 noted).
skeptic_panel_summary.what_would_raise_score: Lean-certify the two paper-level pieces (reversible-lift closure + EPR decomposition) end to end, OR deliver a genuine generalization (stochastic-lens DPI; trap beyond product-form mu=pi x s). Absent those, the verdict stays 'correct-but-known recovery'.
skeptic_panel_summary.what_would_lower_score: Writing the note as deriving the Second Law / Past Hypothesis; over-reading F38 as a thermodynamic arrow; dropping the informational-proxy caveat; or claiming the bare NG_PROTOCOL_TRAP theorem proves the holonomy-robust statement -- none of which the repaired card does.
